mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (email, password, nickname, profile_image, role, status) VALUES (#{email}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{profileImage}, COALESCE(#{role}, 'USER'), COALESCE(#{status}, 'ACTIVE'))
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET nickname = #{nickname}, profile_image = #{profileImage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE member SET password = #{password}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
